note: Hand-authored against the in-process emulator. Re-record from real BigQuery once operator credentials are available. Mirrors the multipart upload google-cloud-bigquery's load_table_from_json sends (google-resumable-media framing, envelope key order, media part labelled '*/*'), with placeholders for the project, dataset, and a dataset-derived job id. BigQuery's jobs.insert media upload accepts '*/*' (discovery document mediaUpload.accept) and parses the bytes per sourceFormat.
